mapper.select: SELECT e.evidence_code sourceCode,s.source_code targetCode,'EXTRACTED_FROM' edgeType,'PROVENANCE' semanticType,e.authority_score confidence FROM t_evidence e JOIN t_source s ON s.id=e.source_id WHERE e.knowledge_base_id=#{kb}

SELECT ce.claim_code sourceCode,ce.entity_code targetCode,'MENTIONS' edgeType,COALESCE(ce.relation_role,'SUBJECT') semanticType,NULL confidence FROM t_claim_entity ce JOIN t_claim c ON c.claim_code=ce.claim_code WHERE c.knowledge_base_id=#{kb}

SELECT ce.knowledge_code sourceCode,ce.entity_code targetCode,'MENTIONS' edgeType,COALESCE(ce.relation_role,'SUBJECT') semanticType,NULL confidence FROM t_card_entity ce JOIN t_knowledge_card k ON k.knowledge_code=ce.knowledge_code WHERE k.knowledge_base_id=#{kb}

SELECT se.entity_code sourceCode,te.entity_code targetCode,r.relation_type edgeType,r.relation_type semanticType,r.confidence confidence FROM t_relation r JOIN t_entity se ON se.id=r.source_entity_id JOIN t_entity te ON te.id=r.target_entity_id WHERE r.knowledge_base_id=#{kb}
